entries.head: promql
entries.message: promql: mixed operand is not admitted for %s at %s
entries.rationale: The production paths are lowerCountOrGroupOverMixedExpHistogramSetOp, lowerSortByLabelArg, and preserveMixedPlan. The count/group root path supplies the fixed unexported mixedCountGroupFamily with mixedRootAdmission before loading a recognized mixed-or operand. lowerAggregate reaches the plan path only when mixedAggregateFamily returns that same fixed family, then preserveMixedPlan supplies mixedPlanAdmission only after RowShapeOf reports MixedRowShape. The sort-by-label paths analogously supply fixed mixedSortByLabelFamily operand and plan sites. All four corresponding mixedOperandPolicies registrations are mixedPreserve. Query syntax and configuration can choose the operand but cannot supply a family, site, or policy value; rejection requires internal misuse or deliberate policy-map mutation in tests.
